Prints Solana runtime capture files as YAML with bank, account, and transaction details.

# Purpose
This file implements the `fd_solcap_yaml` command-line tool. It reads a Solana capture file, walks through the file header and chunk stream, and prints the captured data as YAML. The program accepts options for verbosity, slot range filtering, and memory or page settings, then opens the input file and uses `fd_solcap_chunk_iter_t` to scan each chunk in order.

The main processing functions handle bank chunks, transaction chunks, account tables, and account records. [`process_bank`](<#process_bank>) decodes bank preimage metadata and can print account deltas. [`process_account_table`](<#process_account_table>) reads account table entries and can skip duplicate accounts unless the user asks to show them. [`process_account`](<#process_account>) prints account metadata and, at higher verbosity, prints account data as Base64. [`process_txn`](<#process_txn>) prints transaction metadata and error fields, and at the highest verbosity it also prints explorer links for the transaction signature. The file uses nanopb decode functions and Solana-specific encoding helpers to convert binary capture data into readable YAML output.
